name: workflow
description: Lean, risk-budgeted workflows for Kimi Code with one primary path, focused context, selective subagents, single-pass verification, and explicit completion gates.
skillInstructions: Kimi Code compatibility: use the built-in explore, plan, and coder agents only when their task shape fits and the active task-wide agent budget allows it. If a named Codex- or Claude-specific custom agent is unavailable, continue locally unless independent review was explicitly required.

interface.shortDescription: One-path engineering workflow with bounded agents and verification
interface.longDescription: A Kimi Code workflow router with direct, plan-execute, audit, and GitLab review paths, bounded agent budgets, durable MCP-backed state, and a Kimi-native Stop guard for plan reflection and UI reuse evidence.
